_about: GENERATED once, then only edited DOWN. The places that still print a dollar figure without its identifier, per file, on 2026-09-14 (founder rule 11). src/__tests__/guard_figures_declared.test.ts holds this as a ratchet: a file may only print fewer, and a file at zero has its line deleted. When this is empty, every figure a person reads is declared in the code and the master file's rows are printed from the declarations.
_about_percent: Added 2026-10-21 (Performance audit row 9): the places that still print a PERCENT without its identifier, per file — read by the second test in src/__tests__/guard_figures_declared.test.ts. The money baseline above could not see a percent. Same ratchet: each line holds the file's true count, may only fall, and is deleted at zero.
_about_widened: Widened 2026-10-26 (PF-TOOLS): both tests read every place a figure is written for a person — the screens, the components, the sign-up steps (src/onboarding), the hooks, the store, the domain and the doors (MoneyKeel/functions) — where they read the screens and components only. A sentence a function composes put figures on screen that no line here counted: the draw sheet's percents and $49,450 left the sheet for src/domain/decumulation on 2026-10-25 and its line fell from 3 to 0 with nothing declared; they are counted there now. The lines added that day are the debt that was always there, outside the guard's sight — the true number, which may only fall. The same day: ContributionRoomScreen and DrawSteerSheet fell to 0 (every figure declared through its door, MK-MN-M-003 to 005 and 031 to 033 on MK-CF-O-005; the draw sheet's inflation MK-CF-M-083 on MK-CF-O-017), and their lines were deleted. A figure is declared only through the orchestrator that hands it to the screen (the lead's ruling, 2026-10-26): the mortgage comparison card's rates and dollar figures, the draw sheet's rates and the cockpit's catch-up have none, so they stay on this list at their true count. The sign-up recap's lines rose the same day (CLEANUP-LEFT, the tax taken out of pay and the year's tax beside it): of its seven new places, the year's tax (twice) and the rate in the line above it now print under MK-CF-M-044 and MK-CF-M-081, which MK-CF-O-004 hands; the tax taken out of pay, the part not taken out, the rental loss and the two-decimal rate are calculated on the step itself, so they stay here — 138 dollar places and 33 percents, its true count.
